description: image_transcribe on the researcher's uploaded screenshot of the MyHeritage results page, uploads/ma-1855-census-josiah-barnes.png in the ma-state-census-capture-image scenario (ut_search_external_sites_ul3, form 3 of the capture forms). The page is the same results page as ma-state-census-handoff-capture-uploaded's text upload. It is longer than the 300-character `digest.excerpt` (`DIGEST_EXCERPT_CHARS`): with a projectPath the mock stages it and returns `staged` + `digest` with no inline `transcription`, as production does, and the excerpt stops inside result 1's household and never reaches result 2, so the agent has to `sidecar_read` the staged ref to see the whole page. `metadata` is what production returns for a `file` read: the file echoed, the sniffed content type, and the scenario PNG's real size. No `imageRef` and no `viewerUrl`: an upload is already kept in the project and has no FamilySearch viewer.
